author: worker_2
object: Issa Rae's success and content focus
belief: Issa Rae has achieved significant success in the entertainment industry, including Emmy and Golden Globe nominations for 'Insecure', a Peabody Award, Time 100 recognition, and a major production deal with WarnerMedia for her company Hoorae.

author: worker_2
object: Issa Rae's content focus on people of color
belief: Issa Rae and her production company Hoorae feature content created by people of color, including 'Insecure', 'A Black Lady Sketch Show' (all-Black female cast), 'Rap Sh!t', 'Sweet Life: Los Angeles', and her management arm ColorCreative which supports women and POC writers.
